**Finding: compliant (at fallback)** — no redline proposed.

- **Governing law / venue (§ 14(a), p0064):** Delaware law + exclusive jurisdiction and venue in the state and federal courts in New York, New York. Delaware law is an accepted fallback jurisdiction, and the forum is actually our preferred venue (New York County courts). The clause therefore meets the rule on its material terms.
- **Noted, not flagged:** New York substantive law would be the preferred match to the New York forum (wording-level only), and § 8 (p0028) layers AAA Commercial Rules arbitration on top of the exclusive-court submission. That arbitration is domestic with no foreign seat, so it does not hit the walk-away trigger; the inconsistency belongs to the dispute-resolution rule rather than being double-flagged here.
